blocks.text: Fraser Heights homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Fraser Heights, October 2026. Detached houses: 84 listed at month end and 10 sold in October, a sales ratio of 12% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 16 listed at month end and 3 sold in October, a sales ratio of 19% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 46 sold over 5 months against an average of 87.8 listed, about 9.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was October with 10 sold. Condos and townhomes: 9 sold over 5 months against an average of 14.8 listed, about 8.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 3 sold.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Fraser Heights?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 84 houses listed with 10 sold in the month and 16 condos and townhomes listed with 3 sold in the month in Fraser Heights. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Fraser Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 12%, a balanced market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 19%, a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
